osaka_kinryu_ramen_dotonbori.hours_raw: Open 24 hours, every day (Tabelog; may change). Number tag: collect your bowl when called.
osaka_kinryu_ramen_dotonbori.notes: [Ramen · the 24-hour bowl under Dotonbori's giant dragon] Minami's famous all-night ramen stand, known for the huge dragon sculpture over the shop. There are only two choices, ramen (¥900 in October 2026, after a ¥200 rise) or chashu ramen, in a tonkotsu the listing describes as rich, made from pork bones and chicken feet with a secret tare. Most 2026 diners found it surprisingly light, with medium-thin, slightly curly noodles. The fun is the free kimchi, garlic and garlic chives to load in. Take a number and carry your bowl from the counter to tatami or counter seats. Queues are mostly overseas visitors late at night but move fast. Opinions vary: a nostalgic finish to a night out for many, lukewarm and thin for one critic.

chef_bio.background: Multi-shop Minami brand (a reviewer notes the main shop is being rebuilt).
chef_bio.specialty: Tonkotsu ramen with free kimchi and garlic chives.

anecdotes.text: "The broth is pork bone-based but quite light. The noodles are thin, and the added garlic chives and kimchi gave it a nice spicy kick." — October 2026, ramen ¥900 after a night out.
"I remember it being JPY 600 back in my twenties, but now it's JPY 900." — October 2026.

osaka_kamukura_dotonbori.notes: [Ramen · Kamukura's light cabbage ramen on its home street] The Dotonbori shop of Kamukura, now a nationwide chain that long-time fans still call a local treasure, with 71 seats and open from 10:00 to 08:00 the next morning. The signature "delicious ramen" (¥850 in October 2026) is a light, gently sweet, secret-recipe broth heaped with crunchy napa cabbage and thin-sliced pork. The most popular version adds small chashu and a soft-boiled egg (¥1,270); there's kara-age (¥430), gyoza and seasonal bowls such as a hot-and-sour soup with Zhenjiang vinegar and cilantro. Order on the table tablet. It's easy to eat and veg-heavy, though one diner found it too salty, and the noodles are soft, almost udon-like.

osaka_kinkuemon_dotonbori.notes: [Ramen · Osaka Black, the jet-black shoyu, through the night] Since 2011 the Dotonbori branch of Kinkuemon, a shop famous for sharp shoyu ramen, set just off the main strip by the Kinryū queue. It has 41 seats over two floors and is open through the night (24 hours Friday to Sunday). The signature Osaka Black is a glossy jet-black soy broth with chicken stock and a seafood edge, buttery chicken-fat aroma and a faintly bitter soy finish. Choose thin noodles (most recommend them) or thick, topped with chashu, menma, green onion and a soft egg; extra noodles are extra. Also on the menu: Red Shoyu, King Shoyu, and Osaka Kinjou Shoyu, a clear chicken-and-light-soy broth that one 34-visit regular likes at 8 am. Buy a ticket at the machine outside; garlic on request. ¥1,000–1,200 a bowl; a few found it pricey for tourists or the service curt.

anecdotes.text: "The aroma of the rich black soy sauce combined with seafood in the jet-black broth was absolutely delightful! The straight, chewy thin noodles soaked up the black soy sauce soup." — October 2026, Osaka Black ¥1,200 at 5 am.
"The clear broth, made with chicken stock and light soy sauce, is perfect for a refreshing morning ramen." — September 2026, 34th visit, Kinjō Shoyu.

osaka_hayashida_dotonbori.notes: [Ramen · Tokyo's Hayashida right under the Glico sign] The first Kansai branch, opened in 2022, of Ramen Hayashida, a Shinjuku shop famous for queues and run by INGS Co. It's a 16-seat counter one floor below the Glico running man, southwest of Ebisubashi. The signature is a clear shoyu broth of duck and Daisen-dori chicken (¥900; the special with a "Maximum Koitama" egg ¥1,200) on firm, thin whole-wheat noodles, with pork-shoulder and chicken-breast chashu. There's also a creamy chicken paitan, a refined tsukemen (special ¥1,250), mazesoba with truffle-sauce egg, and summer yuzu cold ramen (¥950) with yuzu jelly. Add a TKG or oyakodon (¥350–400). Buy tickets at the entrance machine. Light and quick, with friendly staff: a handy fast lunch when Minami's big names are queuing.

osaka_zundoya_dotonbori.notes: [Ramen · Himeji back-fat tonkotsu, round the clock] The Dotonbori branch, opened 31 October 2025, of Zundōya, a Himeji-founded chain with over a hundred shops (about 106 in Japan and 4 in Shanghai, per a December 2025 visitor). It sits just east of Ebisubashi and is open 24 hours. The broth is pork bone with a slightly creamy soy seasoning and as much back fat as you choose (light, regular, rich or extra rich). Noodles are house-made: ultra-thin straight (recommended) or curly. The motomi (original) ramen is ¥860, ajitama ¥980, and all-toppings up to ¥1,360; summer brought a cold ramen with grated daikon. Season at the table with pepper, pickled ginger, garlic, chili oil, sesame and takana. Buy a ticket outside (transit IC accepted) and head upstairs. A Kansai-friendly tonkotsu with a hint of sweetness.

anecdotes.text: "The broth is made from pork bone, featuring a slightly creamy soy sauce soup with added back fat… The noodles are house-made, straight, and thin, providing a pleasant texture with just the right amount of chewiness." — October 2025, opening day.
"The broth is rich and fatty, yet not overwhelming, packed with meaty flavors… The firm noodles pair perfectly with the large seaweed." — May 2026, late night.

osaka_osaka_ohsho_dotonbori_honten.notes: [Gyoza · Osaka Ohsho's main shop on Dotonbori] The Dotonbori main shop of the Osaka Ohsho gyoza chain: 189 seats over two floors, with back tables upstairs looking over the canal, and touch-panel ordering and payment. The gyoza are the reason to come: juicy enough that one fan skips the dipping sauce. Sets pair them with fried rice (generous chashu), kara-age or a hoikoro set meal (¥1,320 with gyoza). The menu also has mapo tofu, green-pepper beef, chilled Chinese noodles and the punchy lu-su fried rice (¥1,200 as a gyoza set). Plain gyoza are ¥700 here, which one visitor found steep, and the service at the flagship disappointed another. Fast and easy, with a take-out counter.

osaka_ichiran_namba_midosuji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is built from beef bones and chicken; beef replaces pork chashu.
osaka_ichiran_namba_midosuji.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45); open year-round (Tabelog; check the official site for changes). Waits of 30–80 minutes are common; take a QR number.
osaka_ichiran_namba_midosuji.notes: [Ramen · Ichiran's pork-free "no tonkotsu" shop] The one Ichiran operating under its "100% no tonkotsu used" concept: the familiar experience (booth counters with partitions, an order sheet, Arita-ware bowls) but a broth developed from beef bones and chicken, so people who can't eat pork can have Ichiran. Diners call it surprisingly rich and creamy, very like tonkotsu, with the signature red secret sauce. One found it lacked real tonkotsu's punch. Instead of pork chashu there's sweet-spicy seasoned beef (gyūyarō), plus soft salted egg, extra garlic and a matcha pudding. The 100% pork-free ramen was ¥1,280 in July 2026. Expect 30–80-minute waits (scan a QR code and return); a 9 am weekday arrival walked straight in. 25 seats, many overseas visitors.

chef_bio.background: Ichiran chain (ichiran.com); this branch uses a pork-free broth (2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: "This location is quite unique among Ichiran branches, as it operates under the special concept of '100% no tonkotsu used.' They provide a special broth developed using beef bones and other ingredients, ensuring that those who cannot eat pork or pork bones can still enjoy the deliciousness of Ichiran." — June 2026.
"100% Pork Bone-Free Ramen + Soft-Boiled Salted Egg + Extra Gyuu Yaro for JPY 1820. The '100% Pork Bone-Free Ramen' itself costs JPY 1280." — July 2026, right after 9 am opening.

osaka_kinryu_ramen_midosuji.notes: [Ramen · Kinryū's standing yatai on Midōsuji] One of Kinryū's several Namba shops, under a big dragon sign on Midōsuji. It's done in a food-stall style: buy a ticket, then mostly stand at the counter or use the tables by the pavement, with the kitchen in full view. Like the Dotonbori shop, it serves a simple tonkotsu ramen (¥900) that most find lighter than its strong pork aroma suggests, plus free kimchi, garlic and garlic chives to pile on. A seven-time visitor praises the old-school simplicity of a shop that has served for over 35 years; a first-timer was underwhelmed. Turnover is quick and it's open 24 hours, handy at 2 am. Smoking is allowed (Tabelog).

osaka_zundoya_namba_ebisubashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: house-made wheat noodles in a pork-bone broth; fried rice and gyoza on the side.
osaka_zundoya_namba_ebisubashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone broth with back fat, chashu.
osaka_zundoya_namba_ebisubashi.hours_raw: Open 24 hours, every day (Tabelog; may change).
osaka_zundoya_namba_ebisubashi.notes: [Ramen · Zundōya by Ebisubashi, all night] A bright, busy 24-hour branch, since 2021, of Himeji's back-fat tonkotsu chain Zundōya, a few steps south of Ebisubashi. The chain's site says its broth simmers pork heads, backbones and whole bones over high heat for about ten hours. Diners describe it as rich and creamy yet not overly heavy, deepened by back fat. You choose thin or curly house-made noodles, the back fat (light to extra) and firmness (soft to very firm). An ajitama large was ¥1,070 in 2026, with wood-ear mushroom extra. Regulars add the spicy HOT version with bean sprouts, half fried rice and spicy takana, or a summer chilled ramen. Popular with a younger crowd after drinks.

anecdotes.text: "Noodle Type: Thin Noodles or Curly Noodles; Back Fat: Light / Regular / Rich / Extra; Noodle Firmness: Soft / Regular / Firm / Very Firm… Ajitama Ramen (Large) (JPY 1,070) + Kikurage W (JPY 220)." — September 2026, quoting the chain's site on a 10-hour pork-bone simmer.
"This rich yet not overly heavy tonkotsu broth is truly addictive. I also appreciated being able to customize the amount of back fat and the firmness of the noodles." — July 2026.

osaka_zundoya_soemoncho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone broth with back fat, chashu.
osaka_zundoya_soemoncho.hours_raw: Mon 0:00–7:00 and 9:00–24:00; Tue–Sun open 24 hours (Tabelog; may change).
osaka_zundoya_soemoncho.notes: [Ramen · Zundōya in Sōemonchō, the morning-after bowl] A Zundōya branch, since 2022, in Sōemonchō, Minami's all-night entertainment district, open round the clock except a Monday-morning pause. Regulars come for the rich back-fat tonkotsu and the table full of free extras: all-you-can-eat takana, grated garlic, pickled ginger and sesame. One morning visitor found free extra noodles. A negi ramen with curly noodles was ¥980 (bean sprouts +¥110), and a chilled ajitama with grated daikon was ¥1,200 for a large. There are juicy gyoza and fried rice too, plus spicy noodles. Friendly, attentive staff, many from overseas, even at a busy 6 am.

anecdotes.text: "The takana (pickled mustard greens) is all-you-can-eat, and I really appreciate that garlic is available on the table!… It's great that they are open until late at night." — July 2026, a repeat visit.
"Enjoy a morning ramen in the sleepless district of Souemoncho! Hearty Himeji Tonkotsu with a free extra noodle service." — June 2026, Saturday 6 am.

osaka_kamukura_midosuji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; sets add fried rice, gyoza and kara-age.
osaka_kamukura_midosuji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork belly and chashu; a pork-and-vegetable broth.
osaka_kamukura_midosuji.hours_raw: Mon–Thu and Sun 10:00–23:00; Fri, Sat and holiday eves 10:00–07:00 next morning (Tabelog; may change).
osaka_kamukura_midosuji.notes: [Ramen · Kamukura on Midōsuji] A newer Kamukura (opened January 2025) on Midōsuji beside Kinryū, open until 7 am on Friday and Saturday nights. Its heavy entrance door may be why it's often the one shop without a queue. The "delicious ramen" (¥820 in October 2026) is the chain's light pork-and-vegetable broth, not tonkotsu, sweet from crunchy napa cabbage, with pork belly, thick bouncy chashu and chewy medium-thin straight noodles. Sets add half fried rice and gyoza (¥1,370) or kara-age, and there are seasonal spicy-sour noodles (with a black-vinegar version) and a chilled ramen. Help yourself to garlic chives and chili.

anecdotes.text: "The broth had a sweet flavor from the napa cabbage, which added a light yet rich taste… the medium-thin straight noodles had a great chewiness. The thick chashu was tender and had a good bounce to it." — October 2026.
"Delicious Ramen: JPY 820 – Half Fried Rice and Gyoza Set: JPY 1,370. You can help yourself to the garlic chives and chili peppers!" — October 2026, ramen stop #130.

osaka_shitenno_dotonbori.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in shoyu and miso broths; kara-age and fried rice sets.
osaka_shitenno_dotonbori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken-paitan base, chashu, kara-age.
osaka_shitenno_dotonbori.hours_raw: Tabelog says to check the shop's website for hours; 2026 reviewers describe it as open 24 hours. Open year-round. Ticket machine.
osaka_shitenno_dotonbori.notes: [Ramen · Shitennō on Dotonbori's ramen strip] A 32-seat, two-floor ramen shop, since 2021, on the Sennichimae stretch of Dotonbori lined with Kinkuemon, Ichiran, Kamukura and Kinryū. The broth has a rich chicken-paitan base that diners find surprisingly refreshing. The favourite is miso ramen, bold and salty, with onion, garlic chives and chili, thin straight noodles, chashu and bean sprouts. Shoyu ramen and kara-age sets are on offer too. At ¥1,200 for ramen with fried rice it's cheaper than most of its neighbours. Buy a ticket at the machine. Mostly overseas customers, plus some Japanese regulars; reviewers say it's open 24 hours.

anecdotes.text: "The soup has a rich chicken paitan base, surprisingly refreshing in flavor… The crunchiness of the green onions and bean sprouts adds a nice balance to the dish." — April 2026.
"While most places charge over JPY 1000, the ramen and fried rice set here is a great deal at JPY 1200." — September 2026.
